notes:
REF-BM-02: Saving performs no remote metadata collection and stores no favicon or preview image.
REF-BM-03: Title and description are editable before and after saving, but they are never auto-collected.
REF-BM-04: URL, title, description, and tags are editable, but bookmarks have no note field.
REF-BM-06: URLs are not unique and duplicate saves create additional rows.
REF-BM-07: List cards expose title, description, and tags, but no favicon.
REF-BM-10: Tag input has no autocomplete behavior.
REF-BM-12: Search covers title, description, and URL, but no note field exists.
REF-BM-14: #tag syntax is treated as ordinary literal text rather than tag-search syntax.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators and parenthesized expressions are not parsed.
REF-BM-16: Quoted phrases are not parsed as exact-match phrases.
REF-BM-17: No unread/read-later state exists.
REF-BM-18: No unread-only view exists.
REF-BM-19: No action marks bookmarks read.
REF-BM-20: There is no multi-selection or bulk-action functionality.
REF-BM-21: There is no whole-filtered-collection bulk action.
REF-BM-22: Ordering is fixed to creation date descending with no user-selectable sort.
REF-BM-23: Bookmarks have no markdown note or rendered note view.
REF-BM-24: No local page or PDF snapshots are created.
REF-BM-25: No Internet Archive snapshot integration exists.
REF-BM-26: No archive state or archive action exists.
REF-BM-27: Only permanent deletion exists; reversible archiving does not.
REF-BM-28: No archived-only list exists.
REF-BM-29: No bundle entity or saved-filter functionality exists.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is not implemented.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is not implemented.
REF-BM-32: No display-related personal settings are implemented.
